title: astragalus hornii var. bajaensis
intro: Astragalus hornii var. bajaensis, commonly known as Baja milkvetch, is a plant species in the legume family (Fabaceae). It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote overall health and well-being. The health benefits of Baja milkvetch include its ability to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and immunomodulatory effects.
